title: IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 Out @mha.gov.in, Executive/Grade 2 Result Direct Download Link
fullContentHtml:
The Intelligence Bureau, Ministry of Home Affairs has released the IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 on 5th March 2026 at mha.gov.in. The Tier 2 Written exam was successfully held on 11th January 2026. This is for the Assistant Central Intelligence Officer (ACIO) Grade-II/Executive examination. The IB ACIO Tier II result is released online in PDF format on the official website. This PDF contains the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates for the Tier 3 of selection process. Candidates can check this article to check their results and qualifying marks for the next stage.

IB ACIO Tier II Result 2026 Out @mha.gov.in

The IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 has been released on mha.gov.in. Nearly 37,000+ candidates appeared for the Tier 2 Descriptive Test. Candidates who qualify Tier 2 will be called for the Interview of 100 marks.

Add Testbook as Preferred Source on Google
Add Preference

Shortlisting for the interview is done for 10 times the total number of vacancies, based on candidates’ Tier 1 scores and normalization. To qualify for the interview, candidates must score a minimum of 33% (17 out of 50 marks) in Tier 2.

IB ACIO Result 2026: Overview

The IB ACIO Tier II Result 2026 provides the list of candidates who have qualified the descriptive exam and are eligible for the next stage. Candidates can check their roll numbers from the official website. The selection depends on performance in Tier 1 (Objective Exam), Tier 2 (Descriptive Exam) and Tier 3 (Interview).

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)
Exam Name IB ACIO Grade 2/Executive Examination
Post Name Assistant Central Intelligence Officer (ACIO) Grade-II/Executive
Total Vacancies 3717
IB ACIO Tier 2 Exam Date 11th January 2026
IB ACIO Result 2026 Release Status Released
IB ACIO Tier 2 Result Date 5th March 2026
Result Type PDF Format
Next Stage of Selection Process Interview/Personality Test
Official Website mha.gov.in

IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 Download Link

Candidates can download the IB ACIO Result 2026 PDF for Tier 2 directly from the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The PDF will contain all the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates for the interview stage. Candidates can check the result pdf below.

IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 Out – Click Here To Download PDF

How To Download IB ACIO Result 2026 Tier 2?

To check your IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026, candidates need to visit mha.gov.in. The result pdf shows the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the next stage.

Step 1: Visit the official website: mha.gov.in.

Step 2: Look for the ‘Examination Results’ section on the homepage.

Step 3: Click on the “IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026” link.

Step 4: Download the PDF file.

Step 5: Press Ctrl + F and enter your roll number.

Step 6: If your roll number appears, you are shortlisted for Interview round.

What are the Details Mentioned on the IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026?

The Intelligence Bureau ACIO Tier 2 Result contains important details about candidates who have qualified in the exam. Candidates should verify these details to confirm the result for the next stage.

  • Roll Numbers of shortlisted candidates
  • Recruiting Body Name
  • Exam Name
  • Post Name
  • Tier 2 Exam Date
  • Result Declaration Date
  • Instructions for Tier 3 Stage – Interview

IB ACIO Tier 2 Expected Cut Off 2026

The IB ACIO Tier II Cut-Off Marks 2026 is prepared based on last year trends, difficulty of exam and number of applicants sat for the exam. The minimum qualifying marks for Tier 2 are 33%. The table below is the expected cut-off marks for different categories.

Category Expected Cut-Off (Out of 50)
General (UR) 30
OBC 25
SC 20
ST 20

What’s Next After IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026?

After the release of IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 candidates will be qualified for Personal Interview (Tier III). This stage focuses on their personality, communication skills and intelligence at work. The interview marks will be considered in the final merit list.

Stage Mode Maximum Marks Purpose
Tier III Face-to-Face Interview & Personality Test 100 Evaluates communication, personality, subject knowledge, and overall suitability for intelligence work

IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When will the IB ACIO Tier II Result 2026 be released?

Ans: The IB ACIO Result 2026 has been released on 5th March 2026 at mha.gov.in.

Q2. Where can I check the IB ACIO Result 2026?

Ans: You can find your result pdf from the official website of Ministry of Home Affairs.

Q3. How do I download my IB ACIO Tier II Result 2026?

Ans: You can visit the official website, go to Examination Results and download the ACIO Result 2026 PDF.

Q4. What is the minimum qualifying marks for Tier 2?

Ans: Candidates must score 33% to qualify for the interview stage.

Q5. What should I do after checking IB ACIO Tier 2 Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates must prepare for the Tier 3 Interview and keep documents ready for certificate verification.
